events.title: Dow’s Texas Nuclear Approval Reshapes Long Term Energy And Risk Profile
events.body: Dow (NYSE:DOW) and X-energy received Environmental Assessment approval for their advanced nuclear project in Texas. The U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission issued a Finding of No Significant Impact for the Long Mott Generating Station site.

events.title: Tech and Energy Contribute Heavily to Positive Earnings Outlook
events.body: The overall earnings picture continues to be of all-around strength and a steadily improving outlook, with the Tech and Energy sectors providing big support.
